title: Clarity cadence 1:1 play / prep - Kiera Bennett
content:
Purpose: quick, outcomes-focused 1:1 with Devin (report). Goal: unblock work for the next sprint, align on career growth next quarter, and leave with 3 concrete action items.

Timebox (30m):
  - 0-5m: personal check-in / energy
  - 5-12m: blockers / runway for current tickets
  - 12-22m: roadmap priorities + decisions (handoff, scope trim)
  - 22-28m: career pulse / growth ask
  - 28-30m: confirm actions + calendar follow-ups

Quick context notes (for me):
  - Sprint: feature freeze in 4d. Need to ensure RINF-3456 final checks for canary rollback path done.
  - Oncall this week: Devin covers Tue-Thu, saw two latency spikes on /v1/generate at 2am (likely KV cache pressure). Follow-up: ask whether they reproduced locally with sequence length 2048.
  - Hiring: interviewing for Senior Infra Eng (two onsite slots next week). Devin is on loop for panel 3. Remind them to add feedback rubric.

Opening questions (quick starters):
  - How's your mental load this week? Anything I can take off your plate?
  - Did the kernel patch (PR#762) change perf for your benchmark? Any regression?

Blockers / runway (15m deep-dive prompts):
  - RINF-3456 (canary rollback) - status? Est. time to finish smoke tests?
     - If not green: consider trimming non-essential test permutations for this canary to meet freeze.
  - Latency spikes (2am) - ask: reproduced? which commit? any correlation with autoscale events?
  - Eval regression: prompt truncation failure on the translation eval set. If blocking release, propose temp mitigation: pin model variant to quantized-v2 for the affected route.

Roadmap decisions I may need to give:
  - Scope trim for next sprint: drop 'per-route dynamic batching' MVP if it adds >3d to schedule. Offer to reallocate a headcount from infra backlog to unblock critical canary work.
  - Can we do a limited rollout (5% traffic) to dedicated GPUs in us-west to validate throughput? Ask for a concrete metric to watch (95th latency + token/sec).

Career / growth (7m):
  - Signal: Devin mentioned interest in leading a small cross-functional reliability project.
  - Ask: clarify timeline they want, what support they need (mentorship, time allocation, permission to hire contractor?).
  - Offer: I can sponsor a 1-quarter leadership stretch. Proposed success criteria: ship SLO dashboard improvements and run postmortem playbook for 2 incidents.

Parking lot (for async follow-up):
  - Follow up with SRE about KV cache diagnostics (Slack thread).
  - Put PR#762 perf numbers into the weekly exec slide (small table: before/after p95).

Action items to confirm at end (be explicit):
  1) Devin: finish smoke tests for RINF-3456 and post results in Jira ticket by 2028-03-09 EOD. (linked: RINF-3456)
  2) Me (Kiera): schedule a 30m sync with SRE lead + Devin to review KV cache spikes, target Mon 2028-03-08 AM. Add reproduction checklist to the call notes. (linked: Slack #infra-oncall)
  3) Devin + Hiring: finalize feedback rubric for Senior Infra candidate panel by 2028-03-10. I will block panel times.

Quick follow-ups I will do after meeting:
  - Draft a brief note to Eng Leads about temporary scope trim option (if we decide) so we can reassign one engineer.
  - Add a one-paragraph summary of the 1:1 outcomes to my private manager journal (for calibration).

Notes to self (phrasing / reminders while talking):
  - Keep coaching: reflect what they say about load before offering fixes. Use "what would help most this week?"
  - If they push to keep feature scope, ask for a direct trade (which other thing can be deprioritized?)
  - Use the salary/leveling rubric examples from People Ops when discussing stretch role — have the doc link ready.

Template snippets I might paste into meeting chat quickly:
  - "Confirming actions: 1) smoke tests -> Devin by 3/9 EOD; 2) KV cache sync -> Kiera schedules; 3) hiring rubric -> Devin/Hiring by 3/10."

End-of-meeting micro-retro questions to ask (30s):
  - Was this useful? Anything I should have asked differently?

Draft calendar invite title (if we schedule follow-ups):
  - "KV cache spike review: Devin + SRE + Kiera" (30m)

Revision notes: keep this doc short. Save final action list into the Jira ticket and DM Devin the 3-line summary.

-- scratchy thoughts / extras --
  - If smoke tests flake, escalate to Noelle for CI priority slot.
  - Could ask Product to delay shipping non-blocking telemetry change to avoid adding noise to rollback metrics.

End.
